simple.summary: בַּעֲלָת (Baʻălâth) means Baalath , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 9 18.

definitions.full: H1191. Baalath בַּעֲלָת proper name, of a location Josh 19:44 ; 1Kin 9:18 ; 2Chr 8:6 , a city of Dan, possibly Bel`aîn Survey ii. 296 .
